ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( LOWER(Component_Classname__c) == 'component.c.expstatusbarreport' && (sObject__c == null || (LOWER(sObject__c) != 'contact' && LOWER(sObject__c) != 'client_household__c' && LOWER(sObject__c) != 'case_record__c')), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Report component requires a value for sObject. Value must be one of the following: Contact, Client_Household__c, or Case_Record__c.
